admission.note: Fighting each required character at least once across the corpus is required; stage coverage target is all six legal stages. Random/stage-item matches are rejected, not counted.

description: Public admission template. No replay corpus or qualification evidence is distributed.

entry_schema.characters: external character IDs parsed from settings
entry_schema.result: pass once zero-divergence qualified, else pending
entry_schema.sha256: content hash of the .slp file (dedupe key)
entry_schema.source: dataset name + revision + license + redistribution status

note_on_ids: Character IDs are Slippi EXTERNAL IDs parsed from settings.players[].characterId through the pinned parser table above. Never trust archive paths or bucket labels: some corpora label buckets with libmelee internal IDs, which collides Yoshi and Ice Climbers buckets. External 17 is Yoshi, external 14 is Ice Climbers.

selection.policy: Record local corpus membership and provenance; no private recordings are bundled.
